messages:
Seema: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: asking for a short prioritization note — if teams only have bandwidth for two of the three (API streaming SLA, Console canary UX, Optimize auto-suggestions), which two should be prioritized for enterprise customers and why? looking for guidance to plan PM/eng tradeoffs. :thinking_face:

Dmitri: enterprise-first: 1) API streaming SLA (customers ask for predictable tail latency) 2) Console canary UX (operational controls + RBAC). Optimize is high ROI but lower immediate enterprise blocker.

Liam: can you unpack "why" briefly? e.g., revenue impact / churn risk / engineering lift?

Dmitri: short: SLA reduces churn risk for latency-sensitive apps (high-value accounts). Canary UX unlocks safe rollouts and reduces incidents during deploys (lowers ops load). Optimize gives cost savings but requires careful eval and per-route risk gating. engineering lift: similar magnitude across all three; but SLA+Canary yield faster enterprise wins.

Natasha: teams building consumer-facing features will argue Optimize helps unit economics. is there a suggested sequencing to still keep Optimize moving without full team allocation?

Dmitri: yes 1: keep a small Optimize squad focused on suggestion quality (staging + golden prompts) and make it opt-in. That lets product teams pilot while infra ships SLA/canary for everyone.

Seema: actionable next steps? one-line bullets for PMs to communicate to squads.

Dmitri: bullets: - Prioritize: SLA + Canary UX for Q2 enterprise rollout. - Keep Optimize as opt-in pilot: dedicate 20% of infra/ML time for staging and quality metrics. - Prepare migration docs: SLA opt-in steps, canary playbook, Optimize preview runbook.

Seema: thanks. @deploy-bot can you schedule a quick 30min sync with PM leads next Tue to lock priorities?

ploy-bot: Command not found. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: PM prioritization sync, 2026-04-07 10:00am PT. Invite sent. :white_check_mark:

Natasha: tiny ask 1: can we add a note about customer communication windows? we should avoid surprises when SLA goes live.

Dmitri: yes. add a staged comms plan: internal beta -> invited customers -> public announcement. We'll draft comms and link in roadmap doc.

Seema: perfect. closing thread; DM me if you want to join the PM sync.
